pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The empty-table test deletes all rows, and D1 storage is shared across tests within a file. It is safe only because it is the last test in the file.
findings.fix: Re-seed the rows after the test, or keep it in its own file, so adding tests after it later does not break them.
